card.name: Swallowing and entering-body words
card.fires_on: The word swallow or swallowing after 'do not' or 'without', mostly in inhaler instructions. Also weaker on words of entry like 'into' after descending or absorbed.

modes.label: Swallow warnings
modes.description: Swallow or swallowing after 'do not' or 'without' in inhalation or mouth-rinse directions.
modes.example: For oral inhalation only. Do not<< swallow>> tiotropium bromide inhalation

modes.label: Movement into a place
modes.description: The word 'into' or a partial word after verbs of descending or absorption.
modes.example: Undescended testes (cryptorchidism) are testes that remain in the abdomen instead of descending<< into>> the scrotum just before birth.

card.plain: It lights up on 'swallow' in inhaler directions such as rinse and spit without swallowing, and on words about going into the body.
